subscriptions.name: board-wake
subscriptions.description: A task of a granted project became READY, or a task the team has an attempt for changed state, and aicrew did not make the change itself: the team's coordinators are woken.

subscriptions.name: forge-wake
subscriptions.description: A change of an attempt's pull request that needs a decision (a BLOCKER at the head, CI failing, a declared check failing at the head, both gates green, a merge or close): the worker is woken, and the coordinators when it bears on a submit or when the same declared check failed at the bound of heads in a row. Progress alone wakes no one.

subscriptions.name: blocked-wake
subscriptions.description: A worker reported its attempt blocked: the team's coordinators are woken with the reason and the attempt's last observed pull request, to relay what the worker needs or to escalate.

subscriptions.name: automation-wake
subscriptions.description: An automation ran at an extension point of an attempt's pull request. One that failed wakes the team's coordinators with the handler, the subject and the error; one that asked for a model turn wakes the attempt's worker with the turn's content; each role reads a message of its own, holding only its runs. A run that handled its point wakes no one.
